name: MSEarth-Benchmark-Captioning
description: A benchmark for captioning Earth-observation / satellite imagery, measuring models' ability to produce informative natural-language descriptions of remote-sensing scenes. Evaluations compare generated captions to references using standard captioning metrics and focus on domain-specific content (land use, objects, scene layout).
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and used by the remote-sensing captioning community; adoption is growing but still smaller than mainstream image-captioning benchmarks.
